rows.screenRequirement: 만료 문제 행 비활성 및 사유 표시 (만료 = expiry on a problem)
rows.docSource: description.md §4 예외 ('비공개/만료 문제는 행 비활성 및 사유 표시')
rows.liveDbObject: (missing) — problems has no expiry column (no expires_at). Expiry exists only on recommendation_runs.expires_at / recommendation_items.status, not on problems
rows.rationale: description.md §4 (PRIMARY) lists '만료 문제' as a row-disable+reason render need, but problems has NO expiry concept in the LIVE schema. The only expiry in schema is recommendation_runs.expires_at / recommendation_items.status — a problem reached via X-07/R-02 recommendation could be expired at the recommendation layer, not the problem layer. This is a genuine doc↔schema ambiguity (is '만료' about the recommendation or the problem?). ESCALATE as a product/schema question — do NOT add an expiry column to problems. Net-new gap routed to UNRESOLVED per scope rules.
